_metadata.description: Persist component version history and render diffs between versions and between library and adopted copies.

requirements.title: Saving a component records a new version when content or @version changes
requirements.description: Editor save inserts a row into `component_versions(component_id, version, content, changelog_md, recorded_at)` when either the file's content bytes or the `@version` header changed since the previous recorded version. Identical re-saves do NOT create a new version.

validation.notes: Service test saves the same content twice and asserts only one version row; varies @version to assert a new row on bump.

requirements.title: List and fetch versions per component via API and CLI
requirements.description: `GET /api/v1/components/{id}/versions` lists; `GET /.../versions/{version}` returns content + changelog. CLI: `react-component-library versions list <id>` and `react-component-library versions show <id> <version>`.

validation.notes: Handler tests cover list/show; CLI smoke test exercises both verbs.

requirements.title: Diff viewer renders side-by-side unified diff between two versions
requirements.description: UI diff page accepts `?component=<id>&from=<v>&to=<v>` (or `from=<v>&to=adoption:<adoption_id>`). Renders a side-by-side unified diff. Library and adopted-copy comparisons use the same renderer.

validation.notes: Component test asserts diff hunks render for a fixture pair; BAS flow `adopt-and-detect-drift` opens the diff viewer end-to-end.
